class.name: LightProbeData
class.brief_description: Stores baked probe lighting and interpolation data independently of lightmaps.
class.description: Contains probe positions, nine signed RGB spherical-harmonic coefficients per probe, tetrahedra, capture bounds and its own bake exposure. Saved as a [code].tres[/code] resource and assigned automatically to [member LightProbeSystem.light_data]. Each system receives its own resource and capture, preserving interpolation across its volumes while keeping different systems independent. Texture lightmaps and mesh atlas mappings remain in [LightmapGIData]. A probe-only bake does not rewrite the lightmap resource. Renderer data is uploaded lazily when a system uses the capture, and unchanged tetrahedra can reuse their runtime BVH cells.

method.name: clear_cache
method.description: Requests a full topology and runtime BVH rebuild on the next successful probe bake. Keeps current lighting. The request is transient and remains pending after cancellation or a failed save.

method.name: get_capture_data
method.description: Returns the serialized capture snapshot: bounds, points, sh, tetrahedra, baked_exposure, interior and stale. Positions and coefficients use the capture frame stored by the systems. The snapshot shares its packed arrays until modified.

method.name: get_coefficients
method.description: Returns nine RGB spherical-harmonic coefficients per position, in position order. Coefficients can be negative and contain HDR values.

method.name: get_points
method.description: Returns baked positions in capture coordinates. Editable placement is stored separately in [LightProbeVolumeData].

method.name: set_capture_data
method.description: Replaces a complete capture snapshot after validating its arrays, bounds, exposure and indices. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA]. Failed validation leaves the previous capture unchanged. Non-empty BSP data is not supported by this resource; it uses a runtime tetrahedron BVH.

members.member: Read-only exposure used to encode the stored coefficients. The renderer applies current camera exposure divided by this value independently of texture-lightmap exposure.
Whether lighting needs a refresh after a lightmap-only bake or placement changes. Systems show this as a configuration warning without a modal dialog.
